title: crataegus tanacetifolia var. orientalis
intro: Crataegus tanacetifolia var. orientalis, commonly known as a hawthorn plant, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including lowering blood pressure, reducing the risk of heart disease, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus tanacetifolia var. orientalis include acting as a vasodilator, improving cardiac function, and possessing antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
